_comment: deployment_config.json - the single versioned unit required by §3 and §17.
§3 states that TC-WPN source code + checkpoint + tokenizer + inference
preprocessing must be treated as ONE versioned unit. This file IS that unit.
app.py refuses to start if the loaded checkpoint disagrees with any value
EVERY FIELD MARKED <FILL> MUST BE COMPLETED IN PHASE 1/2 BEFORE DEPLOYMENT.
Nothing here may be guessed. If a value is not known, the deployment is not
ready - that is the point of the file.
§17 - the reproducible chain, every step traceable.
BLOCKER at the time of writing: no .pt from the clean pipeline is
committed anywhere in tcwpn_test (either branch). checkpoint_sha256
below must be RE-VERIFIED against the file actually uploaded to the HF
model repo. If it was written before the upload, app.py will hard-fail
startup with a hash mismatch - which is the correct behaviour, not a bug.
§15.3 - preprocessing is part of the model. These values MUST equal the
arguments passed to scripts/tokenize_cohort.py for the run named above.
The repo defaults are --max-len 512 --max-chunks 1 --stride 128, and the
frozen five-seed benchmark used max_chunks=1.
§15.4. Left-hand names are the supervisor's; the bracketed name is the
actual PrototypicalModel keyword in src/tcwpn/model.py, which is what the
checkpoint's cfg block records. Values are read from configs/tcwpn_full.yaml.
The quantity TemporalRecencyWeight consumes, stated once so no caller has
to infer it from a stale docstring.
scripts/apply_index_time.py overwrites the column the model reads:
days_before_patient_last_note := days_before_index
days_before_index = (t_index - charttime), clipped at 0
t_index is the index time of THAT NOTE'S OWN PATIENT. sampler.py gives one
support slot per distinct patient, so a K-shot set carries K independent
reference points. There is no shared 'most recent note' axis.
The vendored tc_wpn/model.py docstring for TemporalRecencyWeight still
describes the pre-index-time semantics. It is stale; this block and
src/tcwpn/indexing.py are authoritative. See NOTES_FOR_SRC_TCWPN_MODEL.md.
temporal_input.definition: (t_index - charttime) in days for the note's own patient, clipped at 0
temporal_input.fallback: (query note_date - support note_date); reported as temporal_axis 'approximated'

_comment: §7 - these are two DIFFERENT things and must not be conflated.
AUROC is a threshold-free discrimination metric.
The threshold is an operating point selected on validation (objective f1).
Full precision as locked in results/.../tcwpn_full_k5_seed42/eval_test.json.
Do not round it here; rounding changes predictions near the boundary.
operating_point.threshold_source: locked on the full validation plan, objective=f1, never re-tuned on test

_comment: §15.7 - these are served ONLY from /health. They never appear in a
/predict response.
§17 - a metric may only be published here if it was measured on the
checkpoint named in `provenance`. Values below are the five-seed frozen
benchmark from data/TC-WPN - Phase 3B .../tcwpn_full_seed_results.csv and
the seed-42 eval_test.json in the same repo. Confirm they correspond to
the checkpoint you actually upload before setting metrics_verified true.
The figures 0.9635, 0.8989 and 0.9291 that appear in earlier drafts of the
service-contract document and in the live Space's /health belong to the
ARCHIVED pipeline (keyword gate on positives, text-derived test filter,
support/query patient overlap - see AUDIT_OF_ARCHIVED_PIPELINE.md). They
must not be republished anywhere.
eval_test_blind-anxiety.json, same checkpoint. Anxiety lexicon masked.
Ship this next to the headline number; it is the honest one.
Phase 4, five seeds, paired against aux_only (0.7371). Neither w^T nor
w^C shows a detectable effect once the auxiliary CE head is held
constant. The service may not attribute its score to either mechanism.

research_metrics.evaluation_context: MIMIC-IV, patient-disjoint episodes, index-time protocol, K=5, concurrent detection, prevalence 0.594
research_metrics.caveat: Research metric. Not validated on NHSL data. Not a prospective claim.

_comment: §11 - the contract the central backend codes against.
contract_version 1.1.0 adds the R26-DS-012 §1 common envelope
(subject_id, modality, score, status, captured_at, computed_at,
latency_ms) and per-note days_before_index.
api.evaluated_k_note: The frozen benchmark is K=5 and only K=5. Serving at another K is not wrong, but it is outside what was measured. The backend's support-set selector should default to 5.

_comment: warming_up / insufficient_data / poor_signal / not_validated belong to
C1 and C2.
no_support_set is NOT implementable: a prototypical network stores no
prototypes. build_prototype() runs per request; with K=0 there is
nothing to classify against. 422 MISSING_SUPPORT_SET is returned
instead. (tcwpn_full does carry an aux_head over the query embedding
alone, so a support-free score is technically computable - but
evaluation.py scores the PROTOTYPE path, so the aux head has no
measured performance and is not served.)

scope._comment: §12 - this service answers one question only.
scope.answers: Given this note text and this support set, what does TC-WPN predict?
scope.does_not_answer: What is the final multimodal anxiety risk?
